subject: Vendor onboarding: Merchant identity verification & invoice cadence (Globex Retail)
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@globex-retail.co.uk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@globex-retail.co.uk>
Date: 2027-04-09T08:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood (Globex)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — we're ready to get Redwood set up as a supplier in our AP system so POs can be raised. To avoid delays on the first invoice, can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday?

- Legal entity name and company registration number (UK registered branch if applicable)
- UK VAT number (or EU VAT number) + a VAT certificate PDF
- Registered company address and contact for invoicing
- Bank details (IBAN, BIC/SWIFT) and a bank remittance example (PDF)
- Preferred invoice file format (PDF, UBL/PEPPOL endpoint if available)
- Sample invoice PDF showing where you place the PO number and order line references
- Our vendor portal requires a primary contact email and an onboarding contact. Can you confirm who will complete the portal form?

We attach our AP onboarding form for your reference. Once you upload the documents in the portal link below we'll triage the record and send a vendor ID; approval is usually 2–3 business days after complete evidence is uploaded. If you have any questions about invoicing cadence: our standard terms are Net 60 and POs are required for all invoices.

Portal: https://vendor.globex-retail.co.uk/register

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Supplier Onboarding, Globex Retail Ltd.
[Attachment: APOnboardingForm_Globex_20270409.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@globex-retail.co.uk>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood (Globex)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear checklist and the portal link. We're happy to proceed and will upload the requested items. A few quick clarifications so we align our submission: 

1) Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (we also operate via Redwood EU Ltd. for UK/EU contracts). Which entity should we register under for Globex UK POs?

2) Invoice format: we can produce PDF invoices and also support UBL/PEPPOL via a SFTP/HTTP e-invoice endpoint. Do you prefer a manual PDF upload or automated UBL for faster PO reconciliation?

3) PO placement: we add a dedicated header line "Customer PO#" and repeat the PO per line item. I'll attach a sample invoice and our vendor packet so your AP team can see the exact layout.

Next steps on our side: I'll gather the VAT certificate and bank remittance stub and get the portal form completed today. Laura — looping you in to confirm the EU/UK entity selection and whether we should submit Redwood EU Ltd. documents. Karthik — can you provide the accounting contact name and the sample UBL endpoint details if we go automated?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: VendorPacket_Redwood_20270409.pdf (application/pdf)]

On 2027-04-09 08:12, Sophie Martin wrote:
> Hi Marissa,
> 
> Thanks for the demo last week — we're ready to get Redwood set up as a supplier in our AP system so POs can be raised...

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T13:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood (Globex)

Marissa — thanks for the ping. A few notes from finops before you upload: 

- Entity selection: For UK POs it's usually smoother to register Redwood EU Ltd. if we're supplying from our EU team and have a UK VAT registration mapped to that entity. If the contract is with Redwood Inc., Globex will route payments internationally and require W-8/W-9 equivalents.
- VAT evidence: provide the VAT registration PDF and a screenshot of the VAT gov portal or the certificate.
- Bank details: provide the IBAN + SWIFT; include a bank remittance example (PDF) with the account name exactly as it appears on the bank account. Globex is strict on name matching for SEPA/IBAN.
- Invoice PO mapping: Globex requires the PO number in the invoice header and on each line item. Your sample PDF is fine; if we go UBL we'll need to confirm the invoice schema with their e-invoicing team.

Action items for Redwood (owner in brackets):
- Confirm entity to register (Marissa)
- Gather VAT certificate + company registration number (Marissa)
- Provide sample UBL/PEPPOL endpoint or confirm manual PDF (Karthik)
- Finance contact for portal questions: finance@redwood.com (Ben)

If you want, Ben can join the portal submission and hit submit with you so the record is created under the correct entity and routed to the right payment team.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@globex-retail.co.uk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@globex-retail.co.uk>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood (Globex)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — that all sounds good. Please use Redwood EU Ltd. for this engagement and upload the following to the portal when ready:

- VAT certificate (PDF)
- Company registration number + registered address
- Bank details (IBAN, BIC) and a bank remittance example
- Signed vendor onboarding form (see attached from our initial email)

Once the portal record is complete we'll issue a vendor ID and provide the first PO number. Reminder: POs are required for payment — if an invoice arrives without a matching PO it will be queued and payment delayed.

Portal link: https://vendor.globex-retail.co.uk/register
If you'd like a portal walkthrough call I can schedule one with our AP team tomorrow morning (UK time).

Regards,
Sophie Martin
Supplier Onboarding, Globex Retail Ltd.
[Attachment: Globex_remit_instructions_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
